description: This file defines a Debugger class for managing debugging sessions within the Playwright testing framework. It handles pausing, resuming, and tracking paused call metadata, and integrates with BrowserContext and instrumentation.

classes.name: Debugger
classes.description: A class that manages debugging state, including pausing, resuming, and event emission for debugging events.

methods.name: setMuted
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the debugger, controlling whether it responds to calls.

methods.name: onBeforeCall
methods.description: Handles logic before a call, potentially pausing if conditions are met.

methods.name: onBeforeInputAction
methods.description: Handles logic before an input action, potentially pausing.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses execution, setting metadata and emitting a paused event.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes execution from a paused state, resolving all paused call promises.

methods.name: pauseOnNextStatement
methods.description: Sets the debugger to pause on the next statement.

methods.name: isPaused
methods.description: Checks if the debugger is currently paused.

methods.name: pausedDetails
methods.description: Returns details of all paused call metadata and associated SDK objects.
